title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Five Star Business Finance Limited
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated June 18, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹6.20 lakh (Rupees Six Lakh Twenty Thousand only) on Five Star Business Finance Limited (the company) for non-compliance with certain provisions of ‘Reserve Bank of India (Know Your Customer (KYC)) Directions’ and the directions issued by RBI on ‘Fair Practice Code’.
